verdict.rationale: The portals' own pages show online register search and document retrieval, and an online route to submit publication or deposit orders through the Publikations-Plattform, guided by the Bilanz-Navigator. However, nothing shows that a founder can apply for or complete a commercial-register entry online. Search and retrieval do not count as a form, register, apply, file or pay transaction. missing for 10: evidence of online company registration or application to the Handelsregister, online fee payment, end-to-end filing docs for founders, independent or hands-on confirmation of the submission flow.
